name: Initia iUSD
oneLiner: iUSD is a single-chain Initia wrapper of bridged Agora AUSD; reserve yield is redirected to ecosystem incentives and redemption routes through AUSD.
collateral: 1:1 reserve in Agora AUSD bridged to Initia via LayerZero; AUSD itself is backed by short-dated U.S. Treasury bills, overnight reverse repos, and cash held in a bankruptcy-remote Delaware Statutory Trust managed by VanEck and custodied by State Street
pegMechanism: iUSD is a single-chain wrapper of bridged Agora AUSD on Initia. Each iUSD is minted against an equal amount of AUSD locked at the Initia LayerZero bridge endpoint; reserve yield from the underlying AUSD is redirected by Initia into ecosystem incentives (Echelon lending, liquidity programs, Cabal vaults) rather than to holders. Holder redemption ultimately depends on the AUSD bridge and Agora's direct USD redemption.

notices.title: New chain, no published proof-of-reserves for the wrapper
notices.message: iUSD lives on Initia, a recently launched Move-based Cosmos L1 with limited operational history. Initia has not yet published a dedicated transparency feed for the AUSD-backed iUSD wrapper; reserve trust currently inherits from Agora's published AUSD attestations plus the LayerZero bridge endpoint. Redemption to USD ultimately routes back through the AUSD bridge to Agora.

mintAuthority.summary: Initia iUSD is a single-chain wrapper of Agora AUSD bridged via LayerZero; each iUSD is minted on Initia against AUSD locked/burned at the LayerZero bridge endpoint, so supply is controlled by the bridge/OFT route rather than a local CDP or issuer.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: AUSD is locked/burned at the LayerZero endpoint and re-minted as iUSD on Initia; redemption reverses through the bridge to Agora AUSD.

controls.evidence: Initia materials describe iUSD as backed 1:1 by Agora AUSD bridged to Initia via LayerZero, with holder redemption routing back through the AUSD bridge and Agora's USD redemption.

review.evidence: Initia documentation and coverage describe iUSD as a single-chain wrapper minted against Agora AUSD bridged via LayerZero; the upstream AUSD is a VanEck/State Street T-bill-backed fiat token, and iUSD supply derives from the bridge route rather than a local CDP or issuer mint.
